## Checklist

- [ ] The PR title follows the [commit format](../docs/writing-rules.md#commit-messages).
- [ ] No commit carries a `Co-authored-by` line.
- [ ] Every touched module's `README.md` matches the code.
- [ ] The glossary holds every new term.
- [ ] Every new architecture decision has a decision record.
- [ ] Writing rule 1: every word has one definition and one part of speech.
- [ ] Writing rule 2: every sentence names who or what acts.
- [ ] Writing rule 3: every sentence is short and punchy.
